name: Serge
source:
He's in charge of accounts at the Revue moving amusement park.
He was saved at his previous job by [url=/c83802]Hugo[/url] and since than has been his number one believer.
He usually won't go against anything Hugo says.
He's cool and doesn't show his emotions, so some people are scared of him.
He's strict with himself and others, so he doesn't like people who go easy on themselves.

Hobby: Piano
